data.description: Exquisite 1-3 Bedroom Apartments at Electra, JVC
data.display_address: Electra by Acube Developments, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Electra is a prestigious residential development located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, by the renowned Acube Developments. Inspired by the radiant blue-and-white star in the Taurus constellation, this architectural wonder offers a perfect blend of sophistication, tranquility, and active living. The property consists of three basement levels for parking, a four-story podium, and 34 residential floors, offering a mix of studios and 1-3 bedroom apartments.

The interiors feature a bright and modern color scheme, with layouts designed for maximum functionality and a keen attention to detail.

Electra is equipped with a wide range of luxurious amenities to provide an unparalleled lifestyle experience. These include an expansive rooftop swimming pool for adults, a separate children’s pool, a fully-equipped fitness center, a spa and sauna, a Jacuzzi, indoor and outdoor children’s play areas, a dedicated yoga zone, barbecue and picnic spaces, a cinema, and a mini-golf course.

Strategically located, Electra offers easy access to the city’s key facilities and infrastructure. Nearby, you will find medical centers, pharmacies, schools, kindergartens, cafes, restaurants, and supermarkets. The development is just 15 minutes from the city center and Burj Khalifa, 10 minutes from the Mall of the Emirates, 15 minutes from Burj Al Arab, 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 20 minutes from Expo 2020.
